identity_brief: Preserve exact identity of the first full-body front side back reference; second is style and face proportions only. Cute compact chibi anime whale girl, large blue eyes, dark royal-blue hair fading cyan at long ends, small hair curl, whale-fin-shaped side hair, white frilled maid headband with blue bows, navy maid dress, white frilled apron bearing a simple tiny blue whale silhouette, white tights, navy Mary Jane shoes. One thick dark blue whale tail attaches beneath the rear waist bow and curves beside her; whole tail stays connected. Simplify gold trim to readable details. No held plush, no loose prop, no text or speech bubbles. Clean two-dimensional anime sticker art with slim navy outlines, soft restrained cel shading. Front-facing anchored stance as base; keep full feet and entire whale tail in frame. Symmetric accessories suitable for directional mirroring. No shadows, gradients in background or decorative effects.
